name: animated-hover-card
title: Animated Hover Card
description: A preview that appears when you hover a link.

props.name: theme
props.label: Theme
props.description: Colour palette, card included. Its primary colour fills the card's button.

props.name: mode
props.label: Mode
props.description: Light or dark version of the palette. Starts dark.

props.name: site
props.label: Website
props.description: Website the card previews. Needs Card shows set to Website preview.

props.name: source
props.label: Card shows
props.description: What the card shows: a preview of the website or manually written details.

props.name: contentAnimation
props.label: Content animation
props.description: How the card appears: scales and fades, or only fades.

props.name: startScale
props.label: Start scale
props.description: Size the card starts from when it opens, as a fraction of full size.

props.name: fadeContent
props.label: Fade content
props.description: Fades the card contents in as it opens.

props.name: openDelay
props.label: Open after
props.description: How long you hover before the card opens, in seconds.

props.name: closeDelay
props.label: Close after
props.description: How long after leaving before the card closes, in seconds.

props.name: followCursor
props.label: Follow the pointer
props.description: The card follows the pointer instead of staying put.

props.name: underline
props.label: Underline draws in
props.description: The link underline draws in on hover.
